correctness.rationale: An exact greedy-partial-sum proof bounds every relevant minimal length by the support diameter; monotonicity of chi reduces all counterexamples to bounded witness supports. The exhaustive code enumerates 2703 zero-sum candidates at diameter nine and all smaller diameters, exactly testing their positive/negative signs, spans, primitive pair bounds and all nonempty proper zero-sum subsets. Exactly two opposite witnesses survive at nine, none earlier; separate exact multiplicity-vector and support-extension checks prove D=5 and uniqueness. All computations are exact and the finite bounds logically exhaustive.

value.rationale: A concrete motivated inverse problem for an established sharp-bounding invariant is resolved at its first possible obstruction: a globally minimum diameter and unique nontrivial support, not a mere example or cheap normalization. The exact five-atom classification explains how a genuinely four-value sequence exceeds all two-value balances. This sharp finite cutoff is structurally reusable as a benchmark for integer zero-sum and factorization studies.
